verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe per-tool access control (enable/disable individual tools) and gateway routing that lets operators decide what agents are allowed to do, which directly supports allowlist-style restrictions. However there is no evidence of server-level allowlisting, role-based policies, or multi-agent/team-level access control beyond per-tool toggles, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific control working in practice. Missing for 10: server-level allowlists, granular per-agent/team policy management, independent verification of access-control enforcement.
